planets.name: Qatar-6 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Qatar-6 with a 3.51-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: Qatar-6 b was found in 2017 by Qatar as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Qatar-6. Its orbit and size follow Alsubai et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
